# Special tokens: nan (not a number), inf (infinity), empty (MQL5 EMPTY_VALUE).

# VL|name|value|level|expected pass (1/0)        (volume, level rule)
# VA|name|value|mult|h1;h2;...|expected pass     (volume, average rule; history = previous readings)
# VC|name|value|other|expected pass              (volume, cross rule)
